Design identity: Sepid · Medical brand. UI language: Persian, proper RTL. Existing design: Persian RTL futuristic medical brand website «سپید», with art direction inspired by scientific cinema and high-end interactive digital experiences. A huge luminous anatomically inspired GLASS HEART sculpture occupies the central stage, translucent ice-blue arteries with tiny flowing light particles and flowing ribbon-like scan lines that suggest motion, beautiful realistic caustics on a deep midnight-blue background. Not gory, not a real organ photograph. Oversized Persian headline «نبضِ زندگی» layered partly behind the sculpture, with large elegant white typography anchored upper-right and a small appointment module lower-right. Very thin HUD lines connect three tiny medical service indicators to the glass sculpture. High-contrast porcelain-white navigation at top, brand at right, links «خدمات»، «پزشکان»، «تماس» and refined CTA «رزرو نوبت». Bottom transitions into an asymmetric white editorial section with one doctor's small fictional portrait and a service index, not three identical cards. Distinctive, cinematic, expensive 3D motion-design website, not a stock doctor-photo template. No health outcome claims.
